Messages.Author: Gomi no Sensei
Messages.Body:
In article <3c16a6bc.80190565@news>, <Talo...@hotmail.com> wrote:

[card retrieved with Carlotta/Whispers/Sargon must be announced as
part of action announcement]

>Why is that? The text just says to go get a card from the asheap,
>which can only be done if successful.

Actions must specify all their targets when announced. Bum's Rush,
for instance, requires you to name the minion being rushed as the
action is announced; you don't wait until the Bum's Rush action is
successful before naming the minion you'll be in combat with.

Specification of target is also required to distinguish a directed
action from an undirected one (moot for bleeds or rush actions, but
important for, exempli gratia, 'rescue from torpor' actions). If
you didn't specify, the action would be in an uncomfortable limbo
between directed and undirected.

The card being retrieved is a target of the action, and therefore
must be announced.

Only political actions, by the rulebook, have targetting specified after
the action succeeds (but before voting, of course).

gomi
